summary: T15-04 meets every acceptance criterion on evidence. All five story checks passed. The diff touches only apps/web/server/api/{app,problem,targets,targets.test}.ts, all within the files list. The list serves manifest ids only. The detail returns 404 or 501 problems. targets.json is never read. No TargetRecord schema was invented. I found no blocker or high issue; the one low finding is a stale cached path in make test output.

checks.criterion: AC1: GET /targets returns 200 with bundle_version, shipping_mode and manifest id strings only; empty for the mock; OpenAPI says body/footprint not served
checks.evidence: targets.ts:137-147 builds the list from the validated manifest; TargetListSchema is picked from BundleManifestSchema (targets.ts:60-64). The route description names body, footprint and TargetRecord (targets.ts:88-94). Tests at targets.test.ts:94-155 and 377-382 pass (6 files, 132 tests).

checks.criterion: AC2: targets.json is never passed through; its absence is not an error
checks.evidence: targets.ts never reads targets.json. Test 'never serves targets.json' (targets.test.ts:157-171) checks that a marker and 'footprint' are absent from the response. Test 'is not an error when targets.json is absent' (173-181) passes.

checks.criterion: AC3: detail returns 404 problem naming the id and bundle; 501 for a listed id; id pattern and length validated with 400
checks.evidence: targets.ts:149-164 throws ProblemError 404 or 501. The pattern and max length are at targets.ts:36-54. Tests at targets.test.ts:245-337 cover 404, 501, 400 for malformed ids without a bundle read, and an id of exactly 128 characters.

checks.criterion: AC4: response schemas built from the BundleManifest schema plus problem+json; no hand-written target record schema
checks.evidence: targets.ts:60-64 uses BundleManifestSchema.pick and .shape.targets. Tests at targets.test.ts:384-415 assert the shape is identical to the manifest schema and that the only target-named component is TargetList. The TargetRecord gap is named in the code comments and OpenAPI descriptions. The story notes are under scripts/ralph, which the diff excludes, so I did not inspect them.

checks.criterion: AC5: reader fixture with two test ids defined in the test file; list returns exactly them, listed id gives 501, unlisted id gives 404; nulls not coerced
checks.evidence: TEST_IDS is defined at targets.test.ts:39 and the bundle is built in a temp dir. Tests at 117-126, 142-147 and 273-286 assert the exact list, a null shipping_mode kept null, and 501 for listed ids; tests at 255-271 assert 404 for unlisted ids. 294 tests passed.

checks.criterion: AC6: Cache-Control per bundle as in T15-03
checks.evidence: targets.ts:145 uses bundleCacheHeaders('per-bundle', ...) and the route uses conditionalGet. Tests at targets.test.ts:203-242 assert 'public, max-age=300, immutable', the ETag, 304 on a matching If-None-Match, HEAD, and no 304 for an invalid manifest.
next typegen, tsc --noEmit and tsc --noEmit -p server/api exited 0.
ruff, mypy, and turbo lint and typecheck all succeeded. All four turbo tasks were cache hits.
pytest: 404 passed. turbo web tests: 294 passed (targets.test.ts 44 tests), schema tests: 157 passed. Both turbo tasks were cache hits.

findings.claim: The replayed schema test log shows a path under the t7-shell worktree, so that result was a cache hit, not a run in this worktree.
findings.evidence: The log line reads '/nasa-space-apps-challange-worktrees/t7-shell/packages/schema'. The schema package is outside T15-04's diff, so this does not affect the verdict.
